rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (1.0%)
rules.requirement: Eligible Berkeley landlords may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by no more than 1.0% for 2026, and not before January 1, 2026. The AGA is 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase, and landlords must follow the conditions and notice requirements in Regulation 1148.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios elegibles en Berkeley pueden aumentar los límites de renta permanentes de 2025 como máximo un 1.0% para 2026, y no antes del 1 de enero de 2026. El AGA es el 65% del aumento del IPC del Área de la Bahía, y los propietarios deben cumplir las condiciones y requisitos de aviso del Reglamento 1148.
rules.quoted_span: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.exemptions: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents of tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-stabilized units in Berkeley whose landlords qualify under Regulation 1148; excludes tenancies begun on/after 2025-01-01 with Costa-Hawkins-set rents.
rules.caveat: Annual adjustment; regulation text (Reg. 1148) not in document. Section cite from the notice.
